0.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_000
0.description: <hex:022903EB0203>... I didn't know you took part in cosmic exploration! Well, as a member of the scouting party, I reckon I can fill you in on a few things.

12.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_001
12.description: I traveled the realm for decades as an arborist of sorts, visiting my forest village on occasion, until I settled down at Meryall Agronomics in Labyrinthos.

13.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_002
13.description: To think contributing botanical knowledge to the ark project would lead me to the stars... My sweetheart back home would be shocked if she knew!

14.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_003
14.description: But while Auxesian soil is ideal for putting our studies to practice, plants don't grow overnight─so when I have time, I show folks around and check on the trees.

15.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_005
15.description: Well, I hear it's the ninth astral body in the EG-1 star system and over seven carrots from Etheirys, which I've been assured is quite far.

16.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_006
16.description: We got here following a navigational chart left on Oizys by the Voyagers─but whatever we expected to find, it wasn't an entire abandoned city!

17.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_007
17.description: At any rate, Auxesia is easily the most habitable of the three stars we've reached. The environs are so stable, the rainbow crystal need hardly operate at all.

18.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_008
18.description: Yet despite the abundance of aether, not a single soul remains─man or beast─leaving only the plants to benefit. It's almost as though everyone vanished without a trace...

19.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_010
19.description: Timberpond refers to the eastern district encompassing our outpost. Being comparatively clear of trees, like a logging ground, makes for an ideal starship harbor.

20.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_011
20.description: The city stands upon the canopies of colossal trees, aetherically augmented to an altitude of several hundred fulms above ground, with a roadway linking each substructure.

21.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_012
21.description: Do you reckon the natives settled up here in pursuit of sunlight? Honestly, I can't believe nearly all of these buildings are made of wood!

22.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_013
22.description: The Emerald Nervure is a long road that runs through the heart of the city. The way it connects the substructures, like the veins of a leaf, paints a vivid picture of how the Voyagers may have raced along them in their vehicles.

23.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_014
23.description: In fact, I get the sense they had a rather sizable population, too. How many cities of comparable scale can be found on Etheirys, I wonder?

24.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_015
24.description: Given its age, though, I feared the Nervure might crumble beneath our feet. Luckily, I'm told it has all the resilience of reinforced fibers!

25.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_016
25.description: The northwestern cluster looks a bit different from the rest. Like a pastoral landscape, it features more plant life than overtly man-made structures.

26.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_017
26.description: For such an advanced civilization, what purpose might these swaths of empty land have served? Farmland, parkland, or perhaps holy ground?

27.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_018
27.description: Our research is ongoing, but the flora may well hold the answers. Indeed, with a better grasp of the city layout, I daresay full many theories will emerge...

28.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_019
28.description: The Netroot Radius is the southeast substructure, home to the Sprouting Towerling, its supporting facilities, and potentially an aetheric confluence, if the overgrowth is any indication.

29.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_020
29.description: In fact, theory has it that the tower is part of a system which redirects that surfeit of aether to the city core.

30.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_021
30.description: Likewise, the logistics of powering an energization station dictated we build our cosmoport here─and for all we know, perhaps we weren't the first to do so.

31.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_022
31.description: Sylvan Stacks in the northwest features not only the Sunning Towerling but rows of crystals amid the trees, offering an uncommon contrast of green and blue.

32.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_023
32.description: The largest is said to store vast quantities of data, not entirely unlike the “concepts” used by the Loporrits. A crystalline library, one might say!

33.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_024
33.description: With the Sunning Towerling revived, I expect the surrounding crystals are next to be analyzed. I can but imagine how much information lies dormant within...

34.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_025
34.description: The Stratostone Stand refers to the southwestern dome. Like Sylvan Stacks, the tower there stands surrounded by crystals that offer both power and storage.

35.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_026
35.description: We suspect they were all brought here from Oizys. Yet while the city lay abandoned, they've continued to grow in size by absorbing aether.

36.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_027
36.description: The Rooting Towerling, meanwhile, is notable for its separation of the transmitter from the main interior. Both are doubtless vital components, sheltered as they are from the elements.

37.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_028
37.description: Towering to the north, you'll find the Core Shroud, the sacred white forest at the heart of Auxesia.

38.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_029
38.description: The upper level is a series of facilities encased in resin domes. We're currently investigating Grandma Laurel at the center, but the rest are no less functional.

39.name: TEXT_CTSWKS75TIMBERLODGE_00983_SPINA_000_030
39.description: I'm told the names of this and the other towers were designed to reflect a family─and a remarkable one at that, given all its technological advancements!
